pair_map: left[i] <-> right[i]; the right-hemisphere matrix is built in pair order, so it is the mirror-aligned right graph.
clip: Negative wpli2_debiased values are set to 0 before any graph measure; the fraction of negative available intra-hemispheric and homotopic values is recorded per subject, set and band.
masking_rule: Symmetric masking (no imputation): (1) a homologous pair (node) is dropped from BOTH hemispheres when its homotopic edge is NaN or either of its channels has no available intra-hemispheric edge (unavailable channel); (2) among kept nodes, a mirrored intra-hemispheric edge (i, j) is masked in BOTH hemispheres when it is NaN in either hemisphere; masked edges get weight 0 for graph measures, NaN in the edge-difference table, and are excluded from node neighbour counts. Missing data therefore cannot create asymmetry.
zero_rule: Normalized difference (a - b) / (a + b) is 0 when a = b = 0 (both absent: no asymmetry); NaN if either is NaN.
weight_scaling: For clustering and efficiencies, weights of both hemispheres are divided by one shared constant: the maximum available clipped intra-hemispheric weight over both hemispheres (subject, set, band). Ratios I/C are therefore scale-free and unaffected by the scaling.

node_metrics.strength: sum of clipped weights to available neighbours
node_metrics.local_eff: weighted local efficiency (Rubinov & Sporns 2010): sum over ordered neighbour pairs j != h of (w_ij w_ih / d_jh(N_i))^(1/3) / (k_i (k_i - 1)); N_i = available neighbours, d_jh shortest path within N_i with lengths 1/w; k_i < 2 -> NaN
node_metrics.clustering: weighted clustering (Onnela et al. 2005): sum over ordered neighbour pairs of (w_ij w_ih w_jh)^(1/3) / (k_i (k_i - 1)); k_i = number of available neighbours; k_i < 2 -> NaN

network_metrics.glob_eff: weighted global efficiency: mean over ordered node pairs of 1 / shortest path length (lengths 1/w)

deformation.frob: normalized Frobenius ||A - B||_F / (||A||_F + ||B||_F) of the masked, clipped hemisphere matrices (0 when both are zero); frame-invariant
deformation.lapdist: Laplacian spectral distance ||lambda(A) - lambda(B)||_2 / (||lambda(A)||_2 + ||lambda(B)||_2), lambda = sorted eigenvalues of L = D - W (0 when both are zero); frame-invariant
deformation.mwd: signed mean-weight difference (mean_A - mean_B) / (mean_A + mean_B) over available intra-hemispheric edges
deformation.homo_mean: mean clipped homotopic weight over kept pairs

kinds.LR: signed, absolute left/right frame: (L - R)/(L + R) for normalized differences, w_L - w_R for edges; all subjects
kinds.IC: signed, lesion-aligned: ipsilesional minus contralesional = LR for a left lesion and -LR for a right lesion; NaN for subjects whose lesion side is uncertain

lesion.rule: The only read of lesion side in Steps 5-7; used solely to set the IC sign.

regions.rule: Fixed before any label is read. Region value = mean over the region's available pairs of the node-level differences (LR, IC: mean of signed values; abs: mean of absolute values) and of the clipped homotopic weights.
